title: General.
officialText:
Mechanical ventilation systems shall be provided with manual or automatic controls that will operate such systems
whenever the spaces are occupied. Air-conditioning systems that supply required ventilation air shall be provided with controls
designed to automatically maintain the required outdoor air supply rate during occupancy.
